2.0.1: Classical pieces such as Beethoven's Minuet in G now get facts about the right piece.
Artists written with symbols, such as P!nk and Ke$ha, find their songs.
Fewer true facts are dropped, and a few small fixes in Settings.
2.0.0: BubbleFacts 2.0 is here: the first stable release.
AI facts come only from the song's own article and are screened before they show. Press Wrong, or use Hands-free Wrong, to take one off your stream.
Playing originals or other music content creators' songs? Add your own facts in Settings.
2.0.0-rc.2: Facts read more plainly, and fewer wrong ones get through on the default Standard AI.
On a Mac, the window now opens before the sign-in prompt after an update.
Send a beta test report from Help and troubleshooting.
2.0.0-rc.1: High quality AI: fewer wrong facts on computers that can run it. Settings, under Advanced.
More songs find their article, and fewer wrong facts get through.
Turn the LIVE LEARN bubble off under Bubbles, and Bottom center sits at the very bottom when Now Playing is off.
2.0.0-beta.13: Facts you write for a whole game or artist, like [Chopin] in Your own facts, now take turns across their songs.
Each of those songs gets one, and its other bubbles stay about the song. Facts tagged with one song's title work as before.
2.0.0-beta.12: Hands-free Wrong: a key, foot pedal or Stream Deck can mark the bubble on stream as wrong, so you never stop playing. Set it up in Settings, under Bubbles.
Add facts for another song now lets you search your song list.
Bubbles can stay in one fixed spot. Choose it under Where bubbles appear.
Choose Stable or Beta updates in Settings, under General.
